Name: SE_MATERIAL_CONVERT_PARAM_ST
Description: Converts a material ID into the two-digit SE material used by material-dependent sounds. The row ID is the 3-digit material ID.

Fields.Name: SE Material ID
Fields.Description: Two-digit SE material ID that the row's 3-digit material ID converts to.

Fields.Name: SE Material Name
Fields.Description: Material name used to call sounds in Wwise. Half-width characters, at most 16.
